mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 4.5%) signals an accommodative monetary policy environment that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-rate periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE > 4.0%) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 4.0% YoY), the Federal Reserve maintains restrictive monetary policy, increasing discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in residential investment (RSAFS) signals weak consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 95.0) signals weakening supply chain activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 40% of instances when INDPRO < 95.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) signals restrictive monetary policy, increasing discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In tight labor market regimes (UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% YoY), wage pressures intensify, leading to higher inflation and Fed tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.
